title: Dicee Challenge Step 1 - Create an External Javascript File
section: 17. Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game
summary: Step 1 of the Dicee challenge: add a new JavaScript file and link it from the HTML page so later steps have somewhere to put code.

concepts.heading: External script file
points: Create a JS file in the project folder (the lecture names it index.js; the reference repo calls it script.js, any name works if the link matches).
Link it from index.html with a script tag whose src points at the file.
(Extra) Put the script tag just before the closing body tag so the elements it selects already exist when it runs; alternatively use defer in the head.

code_examples.caption: Linking the script at the end of the body

task.name: Step 1: external JS file
task.starting_point: Skeleton Dicee project with HTML and CSS only.
task.goal: Have a JS file loading on the page.
steps: Create a new JavaScript file in the project folder.
Add a script tag with a matching src in index.html, placed just before </body>.
Add a console.log in the file and check the browser console to confirm it runs.
task.expected_result: Page loads with no errors and the console message appears.
task.reference_repo_path: Section 17 - Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game

pitfalls: Wrong file path or name in src, so the script silently does not load.
Placing the tag in the head without defer, so querySelector returns null later.

playground.coverage: No playground lesson yet (no s17.js data file); covered by the proposed Dicee project lesson.
gaps_and_ideas: Include in the Dicee lesson as task 1 with a console.log check.
